acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: AC-1: Fix the shared runtime bug so prov_read, prov_block_read, prov_diff_expand, prov_tree_expand, and prov_worktree_overview no longer crash on staged-only or newly added provenance plugin paths.
AC-2: Add or update targeted tests that cover the failing staged-only/new-path scenario and protect against regression in shared normalization/parsing code.
AC-3: Preserve existing behavior on normal tracked-file inputs and keep plugin validation/tests green aside from documented unrelated pre-existing failures.

data.notes: The crash came from message evidence parsing, not diff/path normalization. Historical provenance review packets store content.summary as structured objects; staged/new provenance paths matched those packets, and evidence/index.ts called trim() on the object while building linked evidence. The fix hardens message field parsing and extracts a string summary fallback from structured summaries.
